title: MammographyAgentFindingCard
description: Standardized Finding Card schema for the Mammography Agent as specified in methodology §3.4.

agent.description: Identifier of the emitting perception agent.

finding.description: Perception findings covering lesion presence, margin, and calcification morphology.

lesion.description: Status of lesion finding (e.g. present, malignant, benign, unavailable).

margin.description: Mass margin classification (circumscribed, indistinct, obscured, spiculated, or null/unavailable if non-mass).

calcification.description: Calcification morphology classification (amorphous, coarse, fine_linear_branching, pleomorphic, punctate, or null/unavailable if non-calc).

BI_RADS_a.description: Agent-predicted BI-RADS diagnostic category (e.g. 2, 3, 4, 4A, 4B, 4C, 5, or unspecified).

path.description: File path to the generated saliency overlay image.

top_regions.description: List of bounding box regions of interest [[ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]].

sh.description: Clinical header / metadata container (empty object if perception agent operates image-only).

rationale.description: Natural language summary rationale synthesized from perception findings.

metadata.description: Governance, audit, and model provenance metadata.
